dashboard.label: TA-zfspool Overview
dashboard.description: Collects storage-pool integrity from whatever is present: ZFS (zpool status/get), Linux md RAID (/proc/mdstat + mdadm --detail) and btrfs (filesystem usage + device stats). Emits

search.query: index=main sourcetype="zfspool:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count as Reports by host | table host "Last seen" Reports
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="zfspool.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)
index=main sourcetype="zfspool:status" _raw="*alarm*" | sort - _time | table _time host _raw | rename _raw as Event | head 200
